content:
Healthier alternatives to instant ramen for my extremely picky eater?
Mom to a 3 y/o princess here. This girl frustrates me to no end when it comes to food, as she does not like to eat! She will say no to practically any type of food. Except for... You guessed it, instant ramen. I know, I know, we should have never started her on the habit, but she stays with my mom while I work. Grandma has a hard time saying no to her and thinks her eating junk is better than eating nothing at all. 

To be fair, she will eat very tiny portions of other food but it takes a lot yelling, chasing her around, pulling out our hair, etc. The instant ramen is the only thing we don't struggle to feed her. She only gets it once or twice a week but ideally I'd like to cut it out completely.

Any recipes/alternatives that have similar taste and texture to instant ramen that she may enjoy? She really enjoys soft textured bland foods so things like vegetable pasta she had not been a fan of. Thanks in advance!
